source: prototype/luna-farm/src/sim_template.html (RULES; plus clock, SEASONS, SEASON_TEMP, SEASON_ODDS and reset() for the outsideRules block)
comment: Every number in the prototype's RULES object, copied exactly, one comment each. `rules` mirrors RULES key for key; RULES.upgrades lives in farm/upgrades.json and is pointed to from here so it is not written twice. `outsideRules` holds tunables the prototype keeps outside RULES.

flockCap.comment: Max sheep + lambs on the farm; no lamb is born at or above it.

woolGrowSec.comment: Seconds for a fleece to grow from shorn to full.

shearReadyAt.comment: Wool level (0..1) where a click shears instead of pets.

lambChancePerSec.comment: Per-sheep chance of a lamb each second while settled and lamb-less.

lambGrowMs.comment: Time for a lamb to become a named sheep.

tuftRegrowPerSec.comment: Grass level a tuft regains per second, capped at 1.

tuftBitePerSec.comment: Grass level a grazing sheep removes per second.

rollEveryMs.comment: Weather rolls again after a uniform delay in this range [min, max].

chance.comment: Base chance a roll brings rain (the season table below overrides it in season mode).

lengthMs.comment: Rain lasts a uniform time in this range; snow lasts up to 1.5x the spread.

realDays.comment: SIM COMPAT ONLY (packages/sim/src/rules.ts, clock.ts SEASON_MS): the old fixed nine-real-day season the sim still reads today. Superseded by outsideRules.seasons.calendar below, the owner's real-year model (2026-09-08); sim ticket #84 retires this field once the sim reads the calendar instead. Do not tune this number for feel any more.

sheepWalk.comment: Sheep px/s when walking to a need (tuft, hay, trough, barn).

lunaRun.comment: DL px/s when running (fetch out, chase, routine moves).

lunaFetchBack.comment: DL px/s carrying the stick back from a throw.

lunaCarry.comment: DL px/s carrying the stick during idle play.

rideMs.comment: How long an autopilot sheep ride lasts.

rideManualMs.comment: How long a button-forced sheep ride lasts.

visitsAt.comment: clock.t fractions (0..1 day) when the farmer arrives; both are daytime.

shearAt.comment: Wool level at or above which the farmer shears a sheep.

everyMs.comment: Delay between the merchant leaving and being summoned again.

stayMs.comment: How long the merchant trades before leaving.

upgrades.comment: RULES.upgrades, the ordered [name, cost] list the merchant auto-buys; kept in its own file with a schema.

petTagMs.comment: How long a sheep's name tag shows after a pet.

outsideRules.comment: Tunables the prototype keeps outside RULES. Copied exactly from the named constants.

periodSec.comment: Default seconds per in-world day; 86400 means follow real time.

odds.comment: SEASON_ODDS: per weather roll, chance of snow then rain, in season mode.

calendar.comment: New for #83, the owner's calendar decision (2026-09-08, plan section 2 'Time' and section 11 decision 10): seasons follow the real year instead of a fixed nine-day cycle. Proposed to the sim lane on #84 as outsideRules.seasons.calendar, sitting beside rules.season.realDays above until #84 retires that field.

nominalRealDays.comment: Nominal length of one season in real days: 365 real days / 4 seasons ≈ 91, a quarter of a real year. The actual length in any run drifts from this by lengthDriftRealDays below, so seasons are 'roughly a quarter but not exactly' as the plan says.

lengthDriftRealDays.comment: A season's real length for one cycle is nominalRealDays plus a value seeded (by the world's RNG seed) uniformly from this [min, max] range of real days, so a season can run from about 81 to about 101 real days and no two years are identical.

startOffsetDriftRealDays.comment: Each season's start date drifts from its anchor (below) by a value seeded uniformly from this [min, max] range of real days, so a season does not begin on the exact same calendar date every year — 'a little seeded drift is the point' (plan section 2).

anchors.comment: The real calendar date (month, day; northern hemisphere) each season begins around, before startOffsetDriftRealDays is applied: the spring equinox (Mar 20), the summer solstice (Jun 21), the autumn equinox (Sep 22), the winter solstice (Dec 21).

firstVisitMs.comment: Delay from reset to the first merchant visit.

initial.comment: Sheep on the field at reset (indices 0..4 of farm/names.json).
